_README: CENTRAL HOLIDAY ADJUSTMENTS for the Normandy Mead collection calendar.
This is the ONE file to edit when the council shifts collections for bank
holidays. Every household's app re-reads it on load, so a single commit here
updates everyone. No app rebuild, no version bump, no reinstall needed.
HOW TO EDIT
1. Open this file on GitHub and click the pencil icon.
2. Add an entry to "adjustments" for each affected collection.
3. Commit. Users pick it up next time they open the app with a signal.
ENTRY FORMAT — 'scheduled' is the normal date the app would have shown;
it is the key, so keep it exactly as the regular schedule would produce.
Moved to a different day:
{ "scheduled": "2026-12-24", "actual": "2026-12-23", "reason": "Christmas Eve" }
Cancelled with no replacement:
{ "scheduled": "2027-01-01", "cancelled": true, "reason": "New Year's Day" }
Same day but the other bin goes out:
{ "scheduled": "2027-04-01", "type": "recycling", "reason": "Easter swap" }
Fields: scheduled (required), actual, cancelled, type, reason.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. 'type' is "general" or "recycling".
IMPORTANT: adjusting a date does NOT change the alternation. The app works
out which bin is due from the regular schedule, then moves that collection.
So a Christmas shift will not knock the general/recycling cycle out of step.
Entries in the past are harmless — leave them as a record, or tidy up
occasionally. Bump 'updated' when you change anything.
